tempo: friday 7.00pm adoration of the blessed sacrament: takes place in the church of the immaculate conception, tempo each friday morning from 10am – 1pm. parishioners are welcome to come along. confessions: in st michael’s chur ch, enniskillen each saturday 10am – 12 noon and 5pm – 5.45pm anniversaries: tempo: friday 6/11 (7.00pm) eileen donnelly & deceased members of donnelly family, main street. sunday 8/11 (11.00am ) johnny & teresa mckeagney. michael mccaffrey. reflection: all saints: there is still more to become our lives are always unfinished. there are hopes we have not fulfilled, mistakes we cannot undo, and experiences that have changed us in ways we never expected. even a good and happy life leaves something still to be discovered and become. today we celebrate the saints: people whose humanity has reached its fulfilment through the love of god. they remind us that we are created for more than this earthly life can contain. but that fulfilment does not begin only after death. jesus shows us, especially in the beatitudes, the goodness towards which we are called: mercy, gentleness, purity of heart and peacemaking. whatever our past, the invitation remains. there are still people who need our love. there are still opportunities to respond to goodness. and through god's grace, even our smallest responses can enlarge our capacity to love. the saints remind us that there is still more to become. god has not finished with us yet. church of the immaculate conception 200th anniversary: we will mark this significant milestone with a celebration mass on sunday 6th december at 11.00am. we would appreciate if you had any old photos, memories or recollections to share. photographs can be scanned and returned to the owner or copies can be forwarded to
